dictionary.lore:
A red lantern crested by a scowling visage. Burns with a fierce fire, and rumbles like thunder.

In some parts of Grand Gaia, such lanterns were said to be the abode of a draconic spirit. Unlike their four-legged winged kin, these dragons are long, slender, and resemble snakes—if snakes were made entirely out of elemental energy.
